review_kind: Single consolidated candidate review; not final task acceptance

profile.authority: Fresh persisted receipt and native routing, launch and provenance checked at review entry.

findings.title: Exclude unambiguous collection expressions and explicit interface declarations from API syntax candidates
findings.observed: Take([ComImport]) and Take(0, [ComVisible]) produce COM attributes. Explicit interface member declarations named Marshal.IsComObject, File.Open and Registry.GetValue produce calls/invocations. Each negative probe returned one candidate instead of zero; genuine COM attribute and call controls returned one as expected.
findings.impact: The inventory claims an attribute or invocation where the concrete syntax is a collection expression or method declaration. Marking runtime binding unresolved does not correct this syntactic misclassification.
findings.required_change: Discriminate these declaration/expression contexts using bounded lexical traversal. Preserve valid attribute, invocation and constructor recognition, exact source anchors, fixed output names and the existing aggregate work/record bounds. Add the five retained negative cases and positive controls to the relevant isolated unit modules.
findings.owner_split: COM owner repairs COM contexts; access owner repairs shared filesystem/registry invocation context. Any shared helper expansion requires coordinator approval.

findings.title: Reject oversized text and invalid capacity values before allocating the access scanner mask
findings.observed: The public access_sites seam invokes strip_comments_and_strings on a 64 MiB-plus-one string before the tokenizer can reject it. An immediate masking sentinel proved this without allocating the actual mask. max_sites=True, False and 0.5 are accepted on empty text despite the documented integer contract.
findings.impact: Direct callers can cause avoidable proportional masking allocation before the documented size rejection, and invalid capacity types bypass construction-time validation. Normal analyzer entry already uses bounded decode; this finding concerns the independently callable scanner seam.
findings.required_change: Validate exact integer capacity types and supported ranges, and reject oversized text before masking/tokenization. Preserve fixed redacted SourceScanError codes and no partial results. Test the retained invalid values and over-limit input with counted or intercepted work, not wall-clock thresholds.
findings.owner_split: Access owner only; no accepted masking/tokenizer implementation change is required.

findings.title: Document the three metadata-extraction comprehensions in the COM project test
findings.observed: The ordinal set comprehension and operation/embed_interop_types list comprehensions at lines 264, 266 and 272 convert metadata and select keys without an immediate intent comment.
findings.required_change: Add a concise intent comment immediately above each comprehension or its containing assertion, or expand it with an equivalent commented loop. Preserve every assertion and all existing test cases.
